install_deps_cmds:
set -e
if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm install 20 && nvm use 20; fi
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates; fi
test -f package.json
test -f package-lock.json
test -f dist/cli.js
node -v
npm -v
npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --registry ${NPM_REGISTRY:-https://registry.npmmirror.com}
